title: ii-V-I in F major
raisedBecause: Seventh chords split between the hands, a left-hand root that leaps a fifth down, then a fourth up, and the G7 voiced without its fifth; the notes alone measure Beginner.
trains: The jazz cadence ii7-V7-Imaj7, split between the hands: the left hand plays the roots, the right hand three notes that move one or two at a time (in C: F A C, F G B, E G B; F stays, then G and B stay). The fifth of V7 is left out.
